statement: Kernel module lizard_mode default true gates native gamepad and sensor emission until gamepad_mode is enabled; 0x42 or 0x45 Menu bit at byte2 bit6 schedules a toggle at 45*HZ/100 nominal 450 milliseconds, canceled upon release. Callback sends mapping/lizard commands, and IBEX gamepad evdev open/close alone does not toggle lizard. Importantly, wired 1302 sensor input callbacks are NOT installed in hid-steam's sensors_register (only 2015 wired and 2026 wireless/BLE install them), so opening wired 1302 sensor evdev does not itself send key48 even though the callback implementation does; SDL explicitly sends key48 on sensor enable.
